findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure use of pickle in pydantic
 * @description Detects uses of pickle that may deserialize untrusted data inside the pydantic package
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pydantic/pickle-usage
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of pickle deserialization inside pydantic; ensure inputs are trusted."
findings.hypothesis: pydantic may use pickle.load/loads internally, which could be dangerous if ever exposed to untrusted data.

message.text: Use of pickle deserialization inside pydantic; ensure inputs are trusted.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous eval/exec usage in pydantic
 * @description Find any use of eval or exec which could lead to code injection if fed untrusted data
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/pydantic/eval-exec
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of eval/exec inside pydantic; ensure arguments are not user-controlled."
findings.hypothesis: pydantic may use eval or exec internally, which could be exploitable if untrusted data reaches them.

message.text: Use of eval/exec inside pydantic; ensure arguments are not user-controlled.
